title: The 80% Pipeline Secret: Why Raw Engineer Stories Outperform Polished Corporate Content
description: Based on a real-world example where 80% of inbound pipeline came from a single, raw LinkedIn essay detailing struggles and revenue, not corporate copy. The idea emphasizes the power of authentic, behind-the-scenes narratives, especially from engineering teams, over highly polished marketing material.
rationale: Extremely high authenticity due to specific, measurable business results ('80% of pipeline') and a bold narrative ('fired our marketing agency'). It's highly contrarian to traditional marketing approaches and offers clear, actionable advice to leverage internal expertise for truly impactful content.
